name: Marcus Girvan
story: Marcus Girvan is documented by Boffa Miskell as a biosecurity project manager and partner managing programmes including LINZ biosecurity and Mid Dome wilding-conifer control. Boffa Miskell also documents 3D web GIS and UAV work for invasive-conifer management. LINZ’s 2015 virtual field trip identified him as its biosecurity subject-matter expert.
LINZ names Marcus Girvan in its geospatial virtual field-trip record: Biosecurity Project Manager, Boffa Miskell, 2015 VFT.
